caption: The drawing consists of three views of a boot: a profile view, a top view, and a frontal view. The main object is a light beige or off-white Victorian-style ankle boot with a short, slightly curved heel. The boot is shown in profile on the right side of the composition, detailed with eight visible round eyelets for button closures running along the front edge, and a gently pointed toe. The heel and sole are shaded with light brown, while the boot itself remains largely uncolored except for the light beige fill. Two smaller, less detailed line drawings are positioned on the upper left side, showing the boot from the top and front, respectively; these are outlined in a fine pencil without coloring. The background is plain and uncolored. The artist’s name, "GEORGITA SPICER," is written in small letters in the bottom right corner.
title: Woman's Shoe
